description: Western Province Provincial Council - Notify the Draft of the Statute of the Motor Traffic of Western Province - 2018
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of a new legal/regulatory framework for motor vehicle licensing within the Western Province. It enacts a statute that creates a new Department of Motor Traffic, outlines its powers and functions, establishes licensing procedures and fees, and provides enforcement mechanisms. The content focuses on creating a regulatory system rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories.
